summary: Manages LLM context generation by providing prompt providers and coordination logic for constructing conversation messages and document structures across multiple system sections.
responsibilities: Provide LLM context prompts and integration points for building conversation structures from document context.
relationships: LLM context prompt provider utilizes rendering components to build conversation messages and structures from document context.
design_decisions: Provides prompt provider variables for LLM context configuration.
Delegates message and structure rendering to child rendering components.
